The petitioners have filed the present petition, inter alia, impugning the notification dated 21.07.2006 issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereafter the 1894 Act) and declaration dated 21.07.2007 made under Section 6 of the 1894 Act.

In addition, the petitioner also impugns the Award No.1/2009-10 as having been lapsed by virtue of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 (hereafter the 2013 Act).
